notes: v001 and v002 are underdetermined and resolve to the base; the ASV translates the base reading in full, so no rule 97 case arises.
Reading σοι as the English subject Thou keeps the verb's own unit to art permitted; folding Thou into the verb and emptying σοι is the competing reading, disfavoured by rule 2.

forth at t016 realizes the preverb ἐκ- of ἐκτείνας and rides inside the verb's unit under rule 106; no expressed preposition stands to answer to it. The juncture and at t019 is a rule 88 helper on the finite verb it introduces.
